g.text: f Harder rules: c430 searches better

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The reward seeker gives more varied answers, but we find little sign of a general skill at finding rules

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Lines and bands: 95% bootstrap intervals. (a, b) Steps 0–4; each point in (a) is one run × rule, and cells within a run aren't independent. High-last-digit runs stopped after about 10 steps and "smallest" paid on half their requests.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: (c) Judged transcripts before takeoff. (e) Two injected runs against three baselines; identical baseline settings gave 17 and 29. (f) A different task: 12 scored examples in the prompt, no training, medium and hard rules.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Without the intro paragraph, oss430 leads that task on the largest and smallest number rules.
